It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 24, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district covers the provincial capital city of [[Mati, Davao Oriental|Mati]] and the southern municipalities of [[Banaybanay]], [[Governor Generoso]], [[Lupon]] and [[San Isidro, Davao Oriental|San Isidro]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 24, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Cheeno Almario]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=October 31, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
